nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 业务需要与10项资产试点
nodes.message:
Hi,

Is your next asset milestone being held up by repeated modeling and file handoffs?

Tripo Studio Team Plan combines text/image-to-3D generation with one workspace, pooled credits and member access controls. Artists can refine starting models in their existing tools, while teammates find shared assets without another file request.

Evaluate 10 real characters or props against your current process: time to a useful model, cleanup, review, handoffs and reuse. Leave your details to plan the pilot scope and access with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

下一阶段的资产交付，是否被重复建模和文件交接拖慢？

Tripo Studio 团队版将文字／图片生成3D与统一工作区、共享积分及成员权限结合。美术可在现有工具中继续精修初始模型，其他成员则能找到共享资产，不必再次索取文件。

用10项真实角色或道具对照现有流程：记录获得可用初始模型的时间、精修、审核、交接和复用。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 规划试点范围及使用安排。

nodes.message:
In Tripo's treasure-chest walkthrough, artists turn a generated base into material variants and an opening interaction. The character walkthrough continues through artist finishing and Unreal checks.

These are Studio production examples. Team Plan separately adds pooled credits, member controls and a shared library. For your pilot, test whether a teammate can find and reuse reviewed assets, rather than request the same file or repeat the work.

Explore the examples, or plan the pilot around your own assets.

这些是 Studio 制作流程示例。团队版另提供共享积分、成员权限及共享资产库。为你自己的团队试点时，要验证其他成员能否找到并复用审核过的资产，而不是重复索取文件或重新制作。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 10项资产的验收及完整投入
nodes.message:
Choose 10 live characters or props. Agree on style, topology, polygon budget, UVs, rigging where needed, export format and engine checks before testing.

Compare your current workflow with generation, retries, artist refinement, review and in-game checks. Record credits, time to a useful starting model, artist hours, time to approval and accepted assets out of 10. Count reuse, file handoffs and admin time too.

Keep input sources, generation settings, review decisions and final versions in your project records, following your disclosure and review policies. Your team decides what ships. Leave your details to agree on scope, access and who runs the pilot.
nodes.messageZh:
选择10项项目中的真实角色或道具。测试前先确定风格、拓扑、面数预算、UV、必要的绑定、导出格式及引擎检查标准。

对照现有流程，记录生成、重试、美术精修、审核和游戏内检查。统计积分、获得可用初始模型的时间、美术工时、通过验收的时间及10项中的通过数量，同时统计复用次数、文件交接次数和管理耗时。

在项目记录中保留输入来源、生成设置、审核决定和最终版本，并遵循自己的内容标注和审核要求。由你的团队决定哪些资产进入项目。留下联系方式，商定试点范围、使用安排和执行分工。

Record integration hours; generation and retry costs; time to first approval; cleanup hours; viewer-check time; and accepted assets out of 10. Include viewer development when comparing total cost.
